description: This PHP source file defines a migration class `GoteoUtf8mb4` for database schema migration. It contains methods to generate SQL statements for upgrading (`getUpSQL`) and downgrading (`getDownSQL`) the database character set to utf8mb4 and revert to utf8, along with placeholder methods for pre- and post- migration hooks.

classes.name: GoteoUtf8mb4
classes.description: A migration class to change database and table character sets to utf8mb4 and utf8 respectively.

methods.name: getUpSQL
